title: Effect of Data Changes on Center and Spread
quartile_convention: median of lower and upper halves, excluding overall median for odd n

practice.prompt: Data 2, 4, 6: add 3 to every value. What is the new mean?
practice.solution: Original data: 2, 4, 6. After the change: 5, 7, 9. Original MEAN = 4; new MEAN = 7.

practice.prompt: Data 1, 5, 9: add 4 to every value. What is the new range?
practice.solution: Original data: 1, 5, 9. After the change: 5, 9, 13. Original RANGE = 8; new RANGE = 8.

practice.prompt: Data 2, 6, 10: double every value. What is the new median?
practice.solution: Original data: 2, 6, 10. After the change: 4, 12, 20. Original MEDIAN = 6; new MEDIAN = 12.

practice.prompt: Data 10, 15, 20: add 7 to every value. Find the new mean.
practice.solution: Original data: 10, 15, 20. After the change: 17, 22, 27. Original MEAN = 15; new MEAN = 22.

practice.prompt: Data 4, 8, 12: subtract 5 from every value. Find the new median.
practice.solution: Original data: 4, 8, 12. After the change: -1, 3, 7. Original MEDIAN = 8; new MEDIAN = 3.

practice.prompt: Data 1, 7, 15: subtract 9 from every value. Find the new range.
practice.solution: Original data: 1, 7, 15. After the change: -8, -2, 6. Original RANGE = 14; new RANGE = 14.

practice.prompt: Data 2, 4, 6, 8, 10: triple every value. Find the new IQR using the median-of-halves convention.
practice.solution: Original data: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. After the change: 6, 12, 18, 24, 30. Original IQR = 6; new IQR = 18.

practice.prompt: Data 1, 5, 9: multiply every value by -2. Find the new range.
practice.solution: Original data: 1, 5, 9. After the change: -2, -10, -18. Original RANGE = 8; new RANGE = 16.

practice.prompt: Data 8, 12, 16: multiply every value by -3. Find the new median.
practice.solution: Original data: 8, 12, 16. After the change: -24, -36, -48. Original MEDIAN = 12; new MEDIAN = -36.

practice.prompt: Data 3, 5, 7: multiply each value by 4 and subtract 3. Find the new mean.
practice.solution: Original data: 3, 5, 7. After the change: 9, 17, 25. Original MEAN = 5; new MEAN = 17.

practice.prompt: Data 2, 4, 6, 8, 10: multiply every value by -0.5. Find the new IQR.
practice.solution: Original data: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. After the change: -1, -2, -3, -4, -5. Original IQR = 6; new IQR = 3.

practice.prompt: Data 4, 8, 12, 16, 20: increase only the largest value by 10. Find the new mean.
practice.solution: Original data: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. After the change: 4, 8, 12, 16, 30. Original MEAN = 12; new MEAN = 14.

practice.prompt: Data 1, 3, 5, 7, 9: replace only 9 with 19. Find the new median.
practice.solution: Original data: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. After the change: 1, 3, 5, 7, 19. Original MEDIAN = 5; new MEDIAN = 5.

practice.prompt: Data 2, 4, 6, 8, 10: add 4 to every value. Find the new Q3 (exclude the overall median from halves).
practice.solution: Original data: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. After the change: 6, 8, 10, 12, 14. Original Q3 = 9; new Q3 = 13.

practice.prompt: Data 1, 3, 5, 7, 9: transform each x to -3x + 2. Find the new IQR.
practice.solution: Original data: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. After the change: -1, -7, -13, -19, -25. Original IQR = 6; new IQR = 18.

practice.prompt: Data 10, 10, 20, 20, 20, 20, 30, 30: replace one 10 with 26. Find the new mean.
practice.solution: Original data: 10, 10, 20, 20, 20, 20, 30, 30. After the change: 26, 10, 20, 20, 20, 20, 30, 30. Original MEAN = 20; new MEAN = 22.

practice.prompt: Data 4, 8, 12: transform each x to 2x + c. If the new mean is 21, find c.
practice.solution: Original mean = 8. New mean = 2 × 8 + c = 21. Thus c = 21 − 16 = 5.

practice.prompt: Data 2, 4, 6, 8, 10: replace only 10 with 30. Find the new IQR.
practice.solution: Original data: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. After the change: 2, 4, 6, 8, 30. Original IQR = 6; new IQR = 16.

test.prompt: Data 4, 6, 8: add 2 to every value. Find the new mean.
test.solution: Original data: 4, 6, 8. After the change: 6, 8, 10. Original MEAN = 6; new MEAN = 8.

test.prompt: Data 2, 6, 14: multiply every value by 3. Find the new range.
test.solution: Original data: 2, 6, 14. After the change: 6, 18, 42. Original RANGE = 12; new RANGE = 36.

test.prompt: Data 5, 7, 9: transform each x to -2x + 5. Find the new median.
test.solution: Original data: 5, 7, 9. After the change: -5, -9, -13. Original MEDIAN = 7; new MEDIAN = -9.

test.prompt: Data 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 24: replace 24 with 42. Find the new mean.
test.solution: Original data: 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 24. After the change: 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 42. Original MEAN = 14; new MEAN = 17.

test.prompt: Data 1, 3, 5, 7, 9: replace only 9 with 29. Find the new IQR (median of halves).
test.solution: Original data: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. After the change: 1, 3, 5, 7, 29. Original IQR = 6; new IQR = 16.
